sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ragman still can't get enough of those sales after you've been running around the Arena in his gear. He even wanted to reach out to you directly, but that's not how business is done. That's between me and him anyway. Your part's simple: just wear the shit we tell you to wear. Show up in the winners' circle in a TV-110. That's all there is to it. Ragman will pay, don't worry."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win 6 matches while wearing a TV-110 plate carrier

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,500 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 63,000 Roubles
- 28 GP coins

sections.text:
